hotspots.name: Your Bed
hotspots.description: A narrow frame, a mattress that has given up arguing, and sheets Melissa changed while you were still unconscious on them.

hotspots.name: The Desk
hotspots.description:
Where it happened. The blotter has been scrubbed and the scrubbing shows.

The notes are still here, in a hand identical to your own: a diagram of concentric circles, four words of a language you should not be able to read, and down the left margin, dates. The last is the night of the crimson moon.

hotspots.name: The Window
hotspots.description: Narcissus Street, three floors down, going about its evening under the gas. Tingen is a mill town pretending to be a university town, and at this hour it stops pretending.

hotspots.name: The Grate
hotspots.description: Coal is dearer than it was. Benson has been burning it in the evenings only and calling that discipline, which is what you call arithmetic when your sister is in the room.

hotspots.name: The Shelf
hotspots.description: Six books, four borrowed from the university and two overdue. A history of the Intis wars, a grammar — and pushed to the back where the light does not reach, a slim thing with no title on the spine at all.

hotspots.name: The Clothes Press
hotspots.description: One good coat, brushed. One working coat, not. Everything in here fits you exactly, which you have decided to stop finding remarkable.
